scope: Protocol identity, official board snapshots, method/model identity, paper-table and source coverage. This targeted audit is not the four-lane whole-literature weekly discovery.
policy: Official leaderboard submissions are first-party result evidence even if no separate paper exists; they must not invent paper records. Official scores have a different trust/protocol regime from heterogeneous cited paper tables.

sources.note: LIBERO standard Spatial/Object/Goal/LIBERO-10 versus original lifelong benchmark; no official 40-task cross-method master ranking claimed.
LIBERO-100 / LIBERO-90 / LIBERO-10 original identities must remain distinct from VLA standard four 10-task suites.
Official requires 50 Clean demos x50 tasks, 100 rollouts/task for Clean and Random, and public code/weights/technical report for listing.
42 sim and 18 real tasks; Score and SR kept separate. 2026-10-09 leaderboard snapshots.
Sep 16–17 simulator get_obs/RGB fixes; not re-running or independently reproducing any method.

findings.detail: Standard VLA four-suite success-rate tables remain separate from LIBERO original lifelong FWT/NBT/AUC, LIBERO-Plus, LIBERO-PRO and LIBERO-Safety. Distinct demonstrations and views are reporting metadata; stricter comparability still requires reading original recipe.
Multiple papers re-report OpenVLA-OFT / π0.5 scores. Existing Result IDs and source versions remain; duplicate cited scores must not be treated as new independent method evaluations.
Official 2,500-clean demo board cannot be called the same controlled leaderboard as paper comparisons using 27,500 mixed clean+random demos, despite equivalent Clean/Random metric columns.
2026-10-11 official snapshot adds ViGAR; 2026-10-02 lists PatchWAM; also ME-Dex-1.0, UniWAM and other models. Show exact official results without pretending that full paper reviews are complete.

All 57 simulation and 11 real official model submissions preserved in separate snapshots; p125 VPP2, p126 InternW0-Δ and p127 GPT-6 Astra have prior full-text reviews. Other model rows must not become fictional paper records.
VPP2-Preview is the prior model version of VPP2, not another scientific paper; two different official rankings and scores are both retained, with explicit variant relation.
Official partial-progress Score and complete-task Success Rate are separate dimensions, never rank a percentage value in a Score leaderboard.
